  on what they want to ask to the development team
title: ''

---

## ❓ Core Petition Details

**1. What is this petition about? (The WHAT)**
(One sentence summary of the desired functionality or change.)

**2. Who is the target user/stakeholder? (The WHO)**
(Which role/group will benefit from this change? E.g., "Admin staff," "External Client Portal users.")

**3. Is there a hard due date or dependency? (The WHEN)**
If yes, specify: Date and reason for urgency. If no, please state: TBD / Low Priority.

---

## ⚙️ Functional Deep Dive

**4. How can we test the correctness of the solution? (Acceptance Criteria)**
Provide a simple step-by-step list that QA can follow to verify the feature works correctly. These must be verifiable steps, not just descriptions.
*   Step 1: [Action]
*   Step 2: [Action]
*   Expected Outcome: (Must see X confirmation.)

**5. Are there any clear boundaries or exclusions? (Out of Scope)**
What absolutely should **NOT** happen in this initial version? This prevents scope creep.
*(If nothing is excluded, please type: "None at this time.")*

---

***Thank you for your submission. The Product team will review these details and contact you to confirm feasibility and priority.***
